faqs.a:
The board may designate a medical committee consisting of two physicians. The medical
               committee shall serve at the pleasure of the board and receive such compensation as
               the board shall from time-to-time determine. The medical committee shall be the medical
               advisers to the board and shall perform such duties as are required of it in this
               chapter.
(Code 1960, § 19-2(I); Code 1981, § 26-31)
